papers.title: A third-moment bound on the contextuality degree of multiqubit Pauli configurations

papers.core_result: Proves a third-moment spectral lower bound on the contextuality degree of N-qubit Pauli configurations with a Kramers refinement for elliptic quadrics, attained on W(5,2) by the Hoggar SIC fiducial, with Lean 4 proofs, independent Python/C verification, and a Moonlab WASM demo.

papers.title: Spectral bounds and their limits in Pauli contextuality: exact configurations and a proof of Jonah's Conjecture E
papers.peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; listed on ORCID)
papers.author: Alexander Stephen Donahue
papers.core_result: Unified study with complete Lean 4.35.0 formalizations of the spectral floor (Theorem 1), Theorem 2 (Kramers / quaternionic floor and elliptic quadrics Q-(2N-1,2)), Theorems 3-4 (5-way saturation equivalences and (2^N-1)|S| = square), exact contextuality degrees (75, 480, 729344) for 4-, 5-, and 7-qubit configurations, a four-qubit cospectral C3 pair with distinct completion spectra (Theorem 14) and separated binary completion minima (Corollary 16: <=344 < 347), general cone lift and case C11 from C3 (Corollary 18), Lemmas 20-21, Theorem 22 (universal cubic-trace identity) and Table 8 outside character sums, and Theorem 19: a full machine-checked Lean 4 proof of Jonah's Conjecture E across all nine vertex cases (C1, C3, C5, C6, C8, C11, C12, C14, C15) for every N >= 4 (plus N >= 3 for C1, C3, C6, C11), accompanied by 97 exact integer checks of Theorem 22.
papers.verification_boundary: As of v1.6.0, the spectral floor, Kramers quaternionic floor, 5-way saturation equivalences, saturated configurations (75, 480, 729344), four-qubit C3 spectral certificate (42 decls) and binary minima separation (Corollary 16), all-qubit C3 family (74 decls), general cone lift and case C11 (Corollary 18), Lemmas 20-21, Theorem 22 (universal cubic-trace identity), and Theorem 19 (Jonah's Conjecture E in all 9 vertex cases for every N >= 4) are all kernel-checked in Lean 4.35.0 (49 audited declarations in VerifyNewFormalizations.lean, 7,686 new library lines, zero sorry, zero native_decide, strictly standard axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]). Remaining outside Lean: state-to-mask identifications of Table 1, Propositions 3, 4, 6 and 8-11, exhaustive enumerations of Theorems 12-13, printed C3 factorizations and relaxation gap 32, and Clifford orbit transport across hyperplane classes via Jonah [J3, Theorem B4]. Historical source manuscripts remain preserved inside the repository as component records of this single combined study (see publication/PAPER-MAP.md).
papers.falsification_command: cd repos/hoggar-bound-lab/lean && lake build HoggarBound.Kramers HoggarBound.SaturationTheory HoggarBound.ConjectureE HoggarBound.ConjectureEExtras && lake env lean VerifyNewFormalizations.lean && cd .. && python scripts/conjecture_e_trace_formula.py && bash scripts/run_all.sh

papers.title: Exact contextuality degrees for disjoint Mermin configurations
papers.peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction)
papers.author: Alexander Stephen Donahue
papers.core_result: Proves exact arbitrary-copy contextuality degree formulas d_k = (7^k - 5^k)/2 for k disjoint Peres-Mermin squares and (6^k - 4^k)/2 for k Mermin pentagrams under full nonempty-union context families, answering Section 6 of Muller & Saniga (arXiv:2609.19862v1).
papers.verification_boundary: Exact multiplicative identity and attaining assignments are machine-checked in Lean 4 (153-declaration axiom audit strictly within standard axioms), paired with independent Python and JavaScript exact enumeration.

papers.title: Certified exact minima of Kochen-Specker sets inside coordinate pools: 31 and 33 rays in dimension three, 18 in dimension four, 29 in dimension five
papers.peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction)
papers.author: Alexander Stephen Donahue
papers.core_result: Certifies exact minimum Kochen-Specker set sizes inside finite coordinate pools: 31 in 3D integer pools (|c|<=2,3,4), 33 in 3D N-th roots of unity (N=6,12,18,24), 18 in 4D {0,+1,-1}, and 29 in 5D {0,+1,-1}, using Lean 4 proofs and independently checked DRUP unsatisfiability certificates.
papers.verification_boundary: Bound-2 3D minimum (31) and 4D minimum (18) are kernel-checked in pure Lean 4 without Mathlib; larger pools rest on independently checked DRUP certificates. Explicitly notes the general unrestricted minimal-KS problem remains open.

papers.title: Contextuality Evidence Lab: Exact Sequential Certificates and a Constructive Setting-Bias Attack
papers.peer_review_status: Research methods artifact & preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction)
papers.author: Alexander Stephen Donahue
papers.core_result: Proves a finite adaptive-tree sequential contextuality evidence theorem and a sharp setting-bias bound for the Peres-Mermin square, constructing an explicit classical adversary causing a miscalibrated 1% test to reject 97.24% of the time while the bias-aware test stays below 1%.
papers.verification_boundary: Adaptive-tree evidence bound, biased-setting classical cap (11/12), and counterexample are formally verified in Lean 4; paired with reproducible Moonlab/QGTL/QRNG/Eshkol simulation. Explicitly disclaims hardware contextuality or certified randomness.

papers.title: Resolution and Lean 4 Formal Verification of Conjecture 7.7 on the Second-Order Variance of Multinomial Discrete Total Variation
papers.peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; 100% Lean 4 kernel-verified)
papers.author: Alexander Stephen Donahue
papers.core_result: Proves Conjecture 7.7 (conj:atriangle) of Banic & Elezovic (arXiv:2610.17046v1, confirmed open in arXiv:2611.14735v1) via an exact 2D-to-1D combinatorial telescoping reduction, sharp non-asymptotic Stirling bounds, and cubic odd-Gaussian Euler-Maclaurin summation, establishing b_0 = 32*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), b_1 = b_2 = -22*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), d_0 = -4*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), a_triangle = 1/32 - 4*sqrt(3)/243, and gamma_2 = -1/(32*pi) - 8*sqrt(3)/(243*pi), rendering linear gamma(n) and cyclic gamma_c(n) unconditional for n >= 5.
papers.verification_boundary: Entire proof of Conjecture 7.7, exact nested-sum fidelity check (hAdj_eq_nested_sum), and unconditional gamma(n) & gamma_c(n) closed forms are 100% kernel-checked in Lean 4 (4,960 lines, 0 sorry, standard axioms only), independently verified in exact rational arithmetic (L=3..45, 0/1 error) and 80-digit Richardson extrapolation (< 3e-55 error).
papers.falsification_command: cd repos/multinomial-tv-conjecture/lean && lake build && lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean && cd .. && python scripts/verify_conjecture.py
